title: Run
desc: Shiva, who comes to Chennai to pursue higher studies, falls in love with Priya on a bus. However, when he learns that her brother is a gangster, he assesses the stakes involved in pursuing her.

title: Gentleman
desc: Kicha is a modern-day Robin Hood, who along with his friend, Mani, steals from the rich to aid the poor. In society, he is a respected man who runs a small business.

title: Parthiban Kanavu
desc: Parthiban, a marketing executive, discovers that the woman he has fallen in love with is the same one that his parents want him to marry. However, after marriage, he discovers an unexpected truth.

title: Raayan
desc: Kathavaraayan, a food-truck owner, leads an honest life with his three siblings. However, a chain of unfortunate events pushes him into the world of crime.

title: Billa 2
desc: Small-time diamond smuggler David befriends Goa-based gangster Abbasi. However, David soon joins hands with an international criminal, much to Abbasi's infuriation.

title: Veluthu Kattu
desc: Kathir decides to change his wayward lifestyle to marry Arukkani and moves to the city. However, when he returns home as a successful restaurant owner, tragedy strikes in Arukkani's life.

title: Teleshopping
desc: The host showcases a range of products manufactured by a reputed brand that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.

title: Roja Koottam
desc: Ilango and Sriram are close friends, who fall in love with the same girl, Mano. However, things take a turn when Mano's marriage is fixed with another man.

title: Ainthampadai
desc: Devasena decides to marry Prabhakaran after she gets a marriage proposal from his family. When she learns that she is chosen to marry his elder brother, she vows to take revenge on him.
